subject: Re: Demo for Redwood Inference — timing & budget window
message_1_body:
Hi Marissa,

I work on ML infrastructure at FintechCo and we're evaluating inference vendors to standardize online scoring. Would love a short demo of Redwood Inference next week to see latency/cost tradeoffs and how the runtime handles our bursty traffic.

I can do 30 minutes on Tue 10/20 or Thu 10/22 (morning PT). Key folks who would join are myself and one of our platform engineers plus procurement for the follow-up. We are also heading into a budget planning window — there's a chance spend decisions will shift until the FY reset at the end of October, so if we need to postpone for timing that's fine too.

Attaching a brief project one-pager to give context.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Platform Lead, FintechCo
message_2_subject: Re: Intro + demo request — Redwood Inference
message_2_body:
Hi Samantha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the brief. I can run a 30-minute demo and tailor it to latency/cost and a short Q&A on procurement needs. Proposed slots: Tue 10/20 at 10:00am PT or Thu 10/22 at 9:00am PT. Which works best?

If it helps, agenda for 30 minutes: 10 min quick product overview, 10 min targeted demo (burst handling, caching, quantization), 10 min procurement/next steps.

Looping in Laura (cc) who partners on procurement and pilot terms — she can advise on pilot options if your budget window is tight. We can hold a tentative slot and move as needed around your FY reset.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
message_3_subject: Re: Intro + demo request — Redwood Inference
message_3_body:
Hi Marissa — thanks for the options. Heads-up from our side: execs just put a temporary spend freeze in place while we finalize the FY budget. We likely won't be able to commit to new vendor spend until after our fiscal reset on 2026-11-01.

I'd still like to see the product to validate fit — would you be able to tentatively schedule something in early November? Nov 3 or Nov 10 would work for me. Also attaching a procurement checklist our team uses so you know what documents folks will ask for.

Appreciate the flexibility.
Samantha
message_4_body:
Thanks for the update, Samantha — totally understand. Let's do this:

1) I'll tentatively reserve Nov 3 at 10:00am PT on my calendar and we can confirm a week prior (or move to Nov 10 if that ends up fitting better).
2) Quick pre-demo (15 min) is helpful to align the agenda and ensure we surface the right performance numbers for your platform engineer. Would you be open to a quick sync the week of Oct 26?
3) I'll attach a short demo checklist and our SOC 2 summary so your procurement team can start the review ahead of time.
4) If the spend freeze remains after your FY reset, we can convert the Nov slot to a technical preview/pilot with month-to-month billing so you can start evaluating without long-term commitment.

Looping Laura to help with procurement docs and pilot structure; she can share contract cadence and any flexibility on billing to accommodate your cycles.

Attachments: Redwood-demo-checklist.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa
message_5_subject: Intro + next steps — procurement & pilot option
message_5_body:
Hi Samantha — Laura here, Account Manager at Redwood. Thanks for flagging the FY timing — that's a common pattern. I've held Nov 3 at 10:00am PT tentatively on our side. If you'd like, we can:  

- Run the 30-min public demo on Nov 3 and follow with a short technical workshop if you decide to pilot.
- Offer a time-limited pilot (30 days) with month-to-month billing and credits applied toward any committed contract executed after your FY reset. That often helps teams start running tests despite internal spend windows.

I'll drop a DocuSign link for a mutual NDA and share a short Drive folder with the SOC2 and technical notes so your procurement can start reviewing: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/ABC123  /  https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

Can you confirm who from your side will attend (platform engineer + procurement contact)? If Nov 3 is confirmed I'll send calendar invites and a short pre-demo questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Laura Bennett
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
